tests.name: cargo test -p galaxian-core time
tests.detail: 10 passed; 0 failed. Includes split_spec_cases (cycle 0, 191, 192, 50687, 50688) and split_roundtrip_with_line_to_cycles.

notes: Spec: type Cycles = u64 (already present in time.rs from T0.2.1) + fn split(c: Cycles) -> (frame, ligne, cycle_dans_ligne).

split decomposes an absolute cycle count into (frame index, line-within-frame, cycle-within-line). frame = c / CYCLES_PER_FRAME; ligne and cycle_dans_ligne are the position within that frame. Inverse of line_to_cycles(frame) + line_to_cycles(ligne) + cycle_dans_ligne.
Constantes used (CYCLES_PER_LINE=192, CYCLES_PER_FRAME=50_688) already defined in time.rs from T0.2.1, sourced from KB-02.
